description: This is a false-colour infrared (FCIR) satellite image showing a rugged, high-mountainous landscape identified as a location of alpine and subalpine grasslands. The upper part of the image features a dark blue/black body of water, likely a lake or deep river. The dominant terrain shows shades of reddish-brown, characteristic of false-colour infrared imagery where sparsely vegetated land or bare rock appears in these tones. Denser vegetation areas are depicted in darker red hues, consistent with the description of grasslands mixed with rocks. The terrain exhibits distinct topographical features, including ridges and valleys. A small, bright green circular marker is centrally placed, indicating a specific point of interest within the grassland area. The image is credited to M. Rodriguez.
